spanish: Hijos de Aser a sus familias: a Yimná, familia de la Yimná; a Yishví, familia del yishví; a Beriyá, familia del beriaí.

findings.issue: הַיִּמְנָה is the article plus an ungendered proper noun, not a masculine gentilic. Spanish «la» supplies feminine article gender the morphology does not mark.

notes: Sons, Aser, the 3mp families, each lamed, and singular familia match; gentilics stay masculine singular.
